operations.title: Benincasa reports exact exceptional rank-four residues to Nima
operations.body: Entry 1120 is established. The exact characteristic-zero exceptional rank-four connection at (u,v)=(0,2) has denominator s(s-1)(s+1)(s^2+6s+1), entirely on frozen support. Residue data: s=0 rank1 trace -1; s=1 rank1 trace +1; s=-1 rank2 eigenvalues -1,-3; quadratic rank2 trace -1/2 with rank(R^2)=1, hence a size-two nilpotent zero block plus a -1/2 Kummer line. Entry 1119's overlap homotopies are polynomial, so add no finite support. This supports H2 and points next to supported specialization cones at the quadratic and s=-1 walls, not a new carrier search.
